scenario_steps.name: Constraint Settings > Inference shows Infer constraints and Persist constraints checked
the user clear Infer constraints and accept
the user reopen the Inference tab
Infer constraints is unchecked and Persist constraints is unchecked and disabled
the user enable Infer constraints
Persist constraints becomes available and remains unchecked
the user check Persist constraints and accept
both settings are restored
the MCAD Software is running
the inference-enabled test line has a displayed persisted constraint glyph
the user right-click that glyph and choose Hide
its glyph disappears and the line remains visible
the user press F8 for Show All Constraints
the test-line glyph and other sketch constraint glyphs are displayed
the user right-click the test glyph and choose Hide All Constraints
the displayed glyphs disappear across the sketch
visible geometry and dimension annotations remain

scenarios.name: constraint-settings-03 Cancel changes to inference configuration

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is running
Infer constraints and Persist constraints and all nine inference types are checked
Parallel and perpendicular priority is selected
the user click Clear All
all nine inference types are unchecked
the user click Select All and then clear Infer constraints
Persist constraints and the checked inference type controls and bulk-selection buttons are disabled
the priority choices remain available
the user click Cancel and reopen Constraint Settings > Inference
Infer constraints and Persist constraints and all nine inference types are checked
Parallel and perpendicular priority remains selected

scenarios.name: constraint-settings-06 Cancel Relax Mode configuration changes

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is running
Relax Mode is disabled with twelve removal choices
Preserve dimensions with equation is checked and disabled
the user enable Relax Mode
the removal choices and bulk-selection buttons and equation-preservation option become available
the user click Clear All and wait for settled painting
all twelve removal choices are unchecked
the user click Select All
all twelve removal choices are checked
the user clear Preserve dimensions with equation
the twelve removal choices remain checked
the user cancel and reopen Constraint Settings > Relax Mode
Relax Mode is disabled and the original removal choices are restored
Preserve dimensions with equation is checked and disabled

scenarios.name: constraint-settings-07 inspect restored configuration through Application Options

scenario_steps.name: an active sketch and Tools ribbon
the user open Application Options Sketch and Constraint Settings
Edit dimension when created and Create dimensions from input values are checked
Warn of overconstrained condition is selected
the user choose Inference
Infer constraints and Persist constraints and all nine types are checked
Parallel and perpendicular priority is selected
the user choose Relax Mode
Enable Relax Mode is unchecked and dependent controls are disabled
the user cancel and close Application Options
the sketch returns to Ready

scenarios.name: constraint-settings-08 Compare visible glyphs after disabling and restoring inference

scenario_steps.name: Precise Input is active in Y-coordinate and X-axis-angle mode
Infer constraints is accepted unchecked
the user create a near-horizontal line with the recorded two pointer clicks
exit Line and select the segment with Show constraints for selected objects enabled
no constraint glyph is visible in that selection frame
the user measure the segment
its displayed length is 19.597 mm
the user exit Measure, undo the segment and restore Infer constraints and Persist constraints
the user create a replacement line using the same pointer clicks
a constraint glyph appears during creation and when the line is selected after Escape
the selection popup identifies a Constraint

scenarios.name: constraint-settings-09 Retain Relax Mode after accepting and restore it

scenario_steps.name: Relax Mode is disabled with its original mixed removal choices
Preserve dimensions with equation is checked
the user enable Relax Mode and accept
the user drag the endpoint of the inference-enabled line twice
the endpoint is highlighted and no visible line movement is established
the user reopen Constraint Settings and choose Relax Mode
Enable Relax Mode remains checked
the user clear Enable Relax Mode and accept
the original disabled preference is restored

scenarios.name: constraint-settings-10 Inspect initial Relax Mode removal choices

scenario_steps.name: Relax Mode is initially disabled
the user enable Relax Mode
Coincident, Tangent, Smooth(G2) and Symmetric are unchecked
Collinear, Concentric, Horizontal, Vertical, Parallel, Perpendicular, Equal and Fix are checked
Preserve dimensions with equation is checked
